d:
Alright... It's the start of the month, and a new story has just been released! Here is Part 10 of the "Dark Fairies" series. In the previous chapter, our heroines rescued a book from an ancient library—a book that might hold the key to saving the magical world... However, darkness has begun to infiltrate the agents' school without the girls realizing it... Will they discover that the enemy is in their midst, or will they eventually fall and join the dark army? It's time to find out!
